radiusSource: Radius 0.758 +/- 0.024 solar radii from Thygesen et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HIP 116454 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..161T/abstract): 527,341 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.8 +/- 0.033 solar masses from Thygesen et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HIP 116454 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..161T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
